name: Pinball Arcade: Cirqus Voltaire
storyline: Cirqus Voltaire (1997): The enchanting Lady of the Cirqus guides the player throughout this highly-rated table designed by John Popadiuk and Cameron Silver. This is the only Williams table to feature a dot matrix display mounted in the playfield and it was the first with a cannon-firing back box. Rising and disappearing below the playfield are a jet bumper and a wise-cracking Ringmaster that taunts the player throughout various modes. The player must light up the Cirqus, unmask Voltaire and then join the cirqus to achieve a multi-level wizard mode and the chance to earn a spectacular grand finale. 2,704 units of this table were produced featuring a variety of different colors of neon tubes and menagerie balls.
